title: Red Flag Rescue Hype Video
description: Davis-Monthan Air Force Base conduced Joint Force Red Flag Rescue training with other various rescue squadrons in the nation. Red Flag Rescue is the world's premier Combat Search and Rescue training exercise that provides total force combat-ready Airmen to rescue and attack in highly contested, austere environments.
